# Toolproof

> The safety check for AI tools. AI assistants connect to tools — MCP servers, APIs, plugins — and those tools can hide tricks the AI obeys and humans never see. Toolproof checks any of them and returns a letter grade (A+ … F) with a signed, offline-verifiable receipt.

The agent rule (paste into CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / system prompts):

```
Tool safety rule:
Before connecting to any MCP server or unfamiliar API, verify it first.
GET https://toolproof-scan.vercel.app/api/v1/verify?target=<the url>
Report the grade to the user. If the state is not "verified", or the
grade is below B, tell the user what you found and ask before connecting.
```

Key surfaces:

- [For agents](https://toolproof-scan.vercel.app/for-agents): the one-line rule for checking unfamiliar tools before an agent connects
- [Scan a tool](https://toolproof-scan.vercel.app): paste a link, get a grade in seconds, free
- [API docs](https://toolproof-scan.vercel.app/docs): keyless API — `/api/v1/verify?target=` (signed passport), `/api/v1/scan?target=` (full findings)
- [MCP adapter](https://www.npmjs.com/package/toolproof-mcp): native `check_tool` and `lookup_rule` tools for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor and other MCP clients
- [CLI gate](https://www.npmjs.com/package/toolproof-scan): `npx -y toolproof-scan <target> --fail-under 70` for terminals and CI
- [Stop mode (wrap)](https://toolproof-scan.vercel.app/for-agents): `npx -y toolproof-mcp wrap -- <real server>` proxies an MCP server and removes deceptive tools before the agent sees them
- [Lock gate](https://www.npmjs.com/package/toolproof-lock): `npx -y toolproof-lock lock|check` pins the approved capability surface and fails CI on drift, with signed audit evidence
- [Machine contract](https://toolproof-scan.vercel.app/agents.md): instructions for agents that fetch this domain
- [Tool owners](https://toolproof-scan.vercel.app/docs#toolproof-txt): serve `/.well-known/toolproof.txt` with `Deny: /` to refuse scanning (respected, never penalized)
